findings.title: shadow-eval JSONL reader aborts on first corrupt line
findings.detail: defaultReadEvalSet in src/agents/shadow-eval/harness.ts calls JSON.parse on each JSONL line without a try/catch. A single corrupt or truncated line causes the entire eval-set read to throw, aborting the run and hiding all other rows from processing.
findings.fix_sketch: Wrap the JSON.parse in try/catch; log a warning for unparseable lines and continue iterating so the rest of the eval-set is still processed.
